items.reason: Artifact discovery assigns type exploration between spec and progress.
Dashboard artifacts consume the same ordered artifact list.
The orphan-markdown validator exempts exploration.md.
Existing validation remains intact, including rejection of other unlisted markdown.
ExploreDeclared reads the set-level explore boolean.
Automatic exploration requires an explicit true value.
ExplorerOverride parses the shared agents-and-effort directive shape.
The guide explicitly contrasts exploration’s opt-in with verify/refine opt-out.
The guide states the shared-seam and later-task dependency rule.
Shared constants supply the names, with a guide-and-validator consistency test.
The explore command launches an agent with task listing, bodies, and available spec.
The prompt requests locations, ownership, invariants, tests, and reading ranges.
The prompt requires cited paths or symbols, roughly one page, and the observed tree.
The exploration template requests no prior art and supplies no prior-art section.
Successful passes atomically replace the flat exploration.md file.
Exploration has its own captured-run phase and retry-cap accounting.
Manual exploration checks neither the declaration nor the automatic config gate.
Failed, timed-out, and interrupted agent runs cannot publish their report.
Integration tests enter ExploreTaskSetWith directly, bypassing the command handler and CLI flags.
Both implement entry points conditionally include the existing report’s path and description.
The implement template receives only the report path.
The prompt permits only corrections to lines falsified by that attempt.
The edit boundary explicitly allows both the task file and exploration report.
The prior-art block is unchanged.
Assist places the exploration pointer between refinement context and recent progress.
Implement and assist goldens cover report-present and report-absent cases.
The drain runs exploration before executing its first selected task.
An existing report bypasses exploration and its spending.
Undeclared sets bypass automatic exploration.
The dedicated work.explore group defaults enabled when either group or key is absent.
The config gate disables automatic passes without disabling manual exploration.
Resolution applies CLI overrides before manifest overrides before configuration.
The exploration phase explicitly skips human-completed sets.
Report reuse depends on presence, without comparing recorded and current trees.
Whole-drain tests assert execution and reuse for absent and existing reports.
The shared fallback walker applies the standard retry cap to exploration.
Exhausted exploration without a report produces EXPLORE-FAILED and stops the drain.
Parking derives from captured-run metadata and report absence without schema changes.
EXPLORE-FAILED is distinct from BLOCKED.
Both READY selectors skip rows demoted to EXPLORE-FAILED.
attendableHITLTaskSets lacks a park filter and can select a parked set with an eligible HITL task.
Exhaustion appends one set-level phase-and-reason record; subsequent parked drains append none.
The forwarded --skip-explore flag bypasses exploration and its parking gate.
A successful manual report or removal of the declaration clears the derived park.
CONTEXT.md lists EXPLORE-FAILED among drain stops and automatic-selection exclusions.
Unexplored marks carry a separate reason rendered in status details.
Undeclared sets resolve to no exploration mark.
Refresh resolves exploration once for the shared rows consumed by all four surfaces.
Work status cells include exploration marks for parked rows.
Manually explored undeclared sets lose their report pointer and recorded tree because resolution exits before checking the report.
The sign-off gate omits an existing exploration report when the set lacks the explore declaration.
ResolveExploreMark treats a completed captured run with a removed report as failure, parking instead of regenerating.

scores.rationale: Shared mechanisms and substantial tests provide a solid foundation, but recovery, fallback selection, and report visibility remain incorrect.
